_note: Task #29 acceptance rules. cadence_floor thresholds FROZEN after calibration (see sw/testdata/cadence_calibration.md). Every rule application is counted by AcceptEngine.hits; a KNOWN_ACCEPTED verdict without a rule hit is an assertion failure in fuzz_classify.classify.

rules.name: brkem_gap
rules._desc: Accepted 8080-mode entry. Positional: first divergent row must be at or after the chip CODE-fetch row that fetched the BRKEM opcode; a divergence before that is a real bug and the rule refuses. Optional IVT-2xMEMR + 3xMEMW push signature upgrades the reason.

rules.name: lea_mod3
rules._desc: Task #30 accepted class: illegal LEA reg,reg (mod=11) loads the chip's stale EA latch, which the behavioural core reproduces exactly only in moffs contexts (cycle-rows always match). Accepts iff the seed carries a lea-mod3 AND the arch-dump diff is confined to that LEA's dest register - strict fail-safe (anything else differing -> refuse -> surface).

rules.name: open_bus_escape
rules._desc: Raw-tier (B) accepted class: execution far-jumped OUT of the loaded 64K image into unmapped space, where the board returns open-bus address feedthrough (data == addr & 0xFFFF) and chip/core desync on garbage operands (task #29 P7, k=16). Positional fail-safe like brkem_gap: accept iff the chip capture shows >= min_escape_fetches feedthrough out-of-image CODE fetches (>= escape_frac_min of all out-of-image fetches) with the escape BEFORE first_bad; a divergence before the escape point is a real in-image bug -> refuse -> surface.
rules._board_vs_tb: Out-of-image reads are BOARD-specific: the board feeds back the address (open bus), the Verilator TB mirrors the 64K image. This rule keys only on the CHIP capture (vctx.real). Banked raw escapes replay chip-vs-TB; the stored round-trip verdict at bank time already absorbs the board-vs-TB out-of-image difference.

rules.name: cadence_floor
rules._desc: Documented waits>=1/wrand cadence-drift floor (biu_model.md:287-536). FROZEN 2026-07-27 from calibration over the 59-seed known-floor corpus (cached w1/w3 chip refs vs current-RTL TB).
rules._provenance: Observed per-step |delta o| distribution was bimodal: a tight cluster at {0,1,2} (normal drift) plus an odd-parity stall family at exactly {8,9,10}, ALL at w1 (odd wait count) - the documented odd-parity 8-cycle stall (biu_model.md). Per the plan, max_step raised 4->9 to admit the legitimate 8/9-clock odd-parity stalls; the single step=10 tail (seed 90042 w1) is deliberately left to surface as TIMING (a conservative top-decile outlier reported for manual review, never silently masked). slip_per_waited_fetch_max/abs_slip_cap/spec_skip_frac_max unchanged: observed worst slip/waited-fetch rate 0.214 < 0.25, |o| peak 10 << 64 cap, fetch-alignment skip fraction 0.000 (perfect) << 0.05. Floor accept-rate with these thresholds: 58/59 = 98.3% (>= the 90% gate).
